collaboration_matrix.completion: Presence refs observed on PubSub, tracker barrier completed, then every view rendered; saves committed and outbox empty; losing same-section drafts preserved; independent-section saves both committed
collaboration_matrix.limitations: One connected record per distinct staff user, one organization per case, four runtime connections; HTTP mounts are sequential, heartbeat/save bursts use a start barrier; draft events are delivered after client debounce; no browser timing, network or polling delay. Presence follow-up SQL is included. Each connected case must finish before the 30-second reconciliation timer. Timings include assertions and observers.

report.completion: Outbox empty after bounded drains on an independent connection; dispatcher committed; all three LiveViews rendered; both record revisions match storage; delivery failure and retry visible without a new ticket revision
report.environment: Local disposable database; runtime login; committed writes; pool size 4
report.limitations: Local synthetic workload, not a capacity estimate. HTTP/LiveView protocol driven in-process; no browser/network latency. Workers invoked explicitly without poll delay. Legacy scenarios exclude presence heartbeats; the collaboration matrix includes explicit heartbeat events. Recovery timers excluded. Operator-only validation queries excluded. Only the outer window traces leases; nested phase query counters add overhead. Control measures one probe pair and includes separate setup/teardown cost. Lease boundaries exclude final handoff bookkeeping.

limitations: Local WSL runtime-role measurements with pool ten for bulk read/command profiles; the committed-cycle diagnostic uses four connections.
First-round reads follow fixture generation and do not represent cold PostgreSQL caches.
Each profile is one acceptance run, not a repeated controlled latency improvement comparison.
VM growth divided by concurrent worker count is an aggregate, not the largest individual allocation.
Idle observations count statements/passes and errors over real ten-minute windows. They do not measure hosted capacity.
Earlier baseline idle statement counts can be compared per equal number of passes; no fresh ten-minute baseline elapsed window is claimed.
No concurrent local tests, builds, fixture generation in another process or hosted browser campaigns overlapped these measurement windows.
The complete hosted original-duration and equal-offered-rate comparisons are reported separately.

operational_lock_increments.scope: Shared standalone visit gate, ticket/session and resource locks, exclusive configuration/closing/outer transactions

protocol.execution: Serial local disposable runtime-role databases; no concurrent builds, tests or hosted browser generators

postgres_wire.scope: All PostgreSQL TCP sockets owned by this benchmark VM, including idle app/operator pools; aggregate phase counters, not a per-request maximum

read_profiles.limitations: Synthetic bulk fixtures; actual runtime login, tenant gates and pool 10. Fresh application per case; fixture insertion warms PostgreSQL/OS caches. Cold is first actor read. Full VM sampled every 1ms includes pools, tasks and off-heap; phase growth is reported both whole and divided by 50 concurrent workers (an aggregate, not a per-worker maximum). Individual caller heap sampled at query boundaries. JSON encoding of fetched rows measures decoded data volume, not PostgreSQL protocol bytes. TCP counters report actual aggregate PostgreSQL protocol bytes, with the per-request mean explicitly separated from decoded per-request maxima. SQL plans and pure policy compilation are separate post-load probes to avoid timing interference. Browser measured separately. No serving database writes.

environment.database: isolated SQL sandbox on local PostgreSQL 16

report.measurement: Serial in-process reads with payload instrumentation included in latency; two warmups and nine raw samples. Bytes are uncompressed Erlang external-term encoding of decoded database result rows, a payload proxy, not PostgreSQL wire bytes or memory residency. p95/p99 are nearest-rank and equal the maximum at nine samples. No HTTP, browser, k6 or concurrent capacity claim.
report.working_tree: Review follow-up: BoardVersions compact batched admission

validation.limits: Current compact admission and board refresh p95 <=500ms and decoded result proxy <=4MiB; legacy discovery is a diagnostic reference only
